confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for July 2026 peak season, not checked against live menus or listings. Restaurant and bar anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which swings sharply with season and availability. Turkish lira volatility also makes USD-denominated tourist prices less stable. FX observation came from a search snippet of the RBA overview page, not a fetched F11 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Turkey is transcontinental and is sometimes grouped as Middle East, but Fethiye's Aegean resort economy is priced closer to Southern European coastal resorts at budget levels. Benchmarked against Turkish Mediterranean and Aegean resorts such as Antalya, Marmaris and Kalkan, plus budget Greek island towns. Cocktail and wine were set using the local relationship to draft beer (cocktail about 1.7x beer, wine glass about 1.3x beer) because direct knowledge of resort bar prices is weak.
